title: Data Communications, Networks and Protocols
keyPoints: Data communications = exchange of data between two devices via a transmission medium.
Four fundamental characteristics: delivery, accuracy, timeliness, jitter (slide 2).
Components of a data communication system (Figure 1.1) and data flow: simplex, half-duplex, full-duplex (Figure 1.2).
Network criteria: performance (delay, throughput), reliability, security (slide 6).
